task.title: Relics: argument errors print the command's own usage
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M41). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

Some argument errors in `workbook relic update` (`--rel` given twice, `--link` with no `--rel`) and `relic list --no-sync` print the top-level usage or "invalid relic arguments". The reference says the command's own usage follows. `--from` with no value also swallows the next flag and reports it as a part that does not exist.

## Wanted

Print the usage of the command that was run, and refuse a missing value as missing.

## Done when

- Each case above prints the usage of its own command.
- `--from --no-sync` is refused as a missing value, exit 2.
